guidance.chooseWhen: Choose and edit a color inline.
features: Immediate or confirm commit mode; controlled/uncontrolled color.
Spectrum, sliders, preview, channel/hex/alpha inputs, swatches and Apply/Cancel parts.
constraints: Parts require ColorPicker.Root; the convenience component assembles a common layout.
Spectrum and selected color are data, not tone. Inputs inherit root tone; their field variant is independent.
Drag presentation freezes React field snapshots until release; native gesture validation is separate from typechecking.
setup: Configure SVG, Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets; no portal/overlay provider is needed.

guidance.valueContract: Color strings; immediate commits during edits, confirm commits with Apply. Spectrum colors are data.

guidance.inheritance: Root owns color/commit mode/disabled/size/tone. Explicit child appearance props override supported inherited props.
